d:
A doujinshi produced by the members of the Hideo Azuma camp, some professional, many amateur, featuring a survey on Bishoujo from the late 1970s to early 1980s. Released March 1st of 1983, this work seemingly was not sold at Comiket as it was published May 1st of that year. Uniquely, this doujin features a hand written 12 on the front cover vs it being printed. Like earlier Cybele-style imprints, is ambiguous in its nature.

The book was sold for a mere 300 yen, though at what conventions/events is unknown. Membership is clearly boasted in the final bylines as are collaborators, but mail order services aren't mentioned. It was more than likely word of mouth or via Anonymous delivery.
